parameters.name: DstTopic
parameters.description: The list of destination topics, which are the topics that subscribe to messages from **SrcTopic**. Specify this parameter in the array format even if only one topic exists. Example: `DstTopic.1=/x7aWKW9****/deviceNameTest1/user/add`, `DstTopic.2=/x7aWKW9****/deviceNameTest2/user/delete`.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: SrcTopic
parameters.description: The source topic, which is the topic that is subscribed to. Example: `SrcTopic=/x7aWKW9****/testDataToDataHub/user/update`.
